program: Community air monitoring and clean-air policy advocacy
priceScope: Conditional annual whole-recipient cost divided by a limited modeled local channel; not a verified marginal gift offer or complete portfolio EV

what: Air Alliance Houston researches air pollution and supports communities exposed to industrial and transport emissions.
It monitors local air and helps residents engage with permits, regulators and public planning.
Its campaigns seek cleaner air and stronger protections for Houston-area neighborhoods.
strengths: Current monitoring provides neighborhood-scale pollution data.
Permit participation links technical research with practical regulatory decisions.
Campaigns identify concrete local sources and affected communities.
reservations: Sensors and comments do not themselves prove exposure or health improvements.
Coalition attribution and implementation remain uncertain and can take years.
Compliance costs, displaced jobs and alternative regulatory action may offset benefits.

model.formula: Union=N*unique*b; clinical=union*completion*q*discounted finite years minus full union harms. Financial=.5*people*discounted one-year log(1+joint net gain/baseline), local share once. Headline=10*C/(clinical+financial).
model.attribution: Annual incremental recipient response is distinct from cohort deduplication and geographic share; no claim of whole annual portfolio or marginal donation causal effect.
model.uncertainty: Source-grounded original cost/services; all causal mapping, utility and net resource priors unsupported. Complete portfolio and marginal donor EV unknown.
